title: gown fold clamp measurement — per-decile, pre/post-fix re-measurement of #691
renderNote: Native 4096 front lit render of the fixed mpfb-gown-adult-patient.glb through the model-vetting three.js path (glb-grade capture 2026-08-29T04-28-03Z; in-page geometry self-check agrees, relativeError 0.00018). Companion passes: front_structure.png / three_quarter_lit.png / three_quarter_structure.png in the same run dir. The fix is the #746 post-fold skin-region clearance push-out at the armpit/sleeve-root; two-tests-agree inside-body count is 0 upper / 0 lower.

method.decilesOver: gown's own y-range 0.568..1.542 m, ten equal bands

interpenetration.primary: even-odd point-in-mesh by +X raycast (Moller-Trumbore, q=s x e1), grid-accelerated over the visible skin primitive mpfb_skin_robert_reference
interpenetration.crossCheckNearest: nearest body triangle signed distance (3x3-cell search, Ericson closest point), inside = sign < -2mm
interpenetration.twoTestsAgree: #714 corrected primary: a vertex counts as inside only when a parity test AND the nearest-surface signed distance agree (either ray + nearest). Single-axis parity is invalid on the non-watertight hull: a ray crossing an open boundary edge flips odd parity without the point being inside.
interpenetration.caveat: the body mesh is not watertight (boundary edges within the gown's y-range); parity can flip near seams — hence the two-ray and nearest-surface cross-checks
interpenetration.validated: centroid and neck test points classify inside, far points outside; hit points keep the ray origin's y/z (invariant checked)

degenerateTriangles.epsilonRationale: area below 1e-8 m^2 = side lengths below ~0.14 mm — below render relevance at the graded 4096 capture; counts below 1e-12 (true zero-area) recorded separately

inwardFacingTriangles.reference: geometric normal points toward the body XZ axis: dot(n, triCenter - axis) < 0
inwardFacingTriangles.caveat: counts inner-sleeve tube surfaces (correct geometry, occluded in the render) and accordion flank normals near dot~0; the nearest-body-surface-normal variant is recorded alongside (biased at free rims: hem/collar/cuffs)

mechanismNote: gown vertices inside the body skin are measured and bodice-concentrated: +X-ray even-odd 329 upper vs 32 lower, +Z-ray 681 vs 169, nearest-surface 75 vs 0. The gather band (automate_blender.py #686: _fold_amp686=0.034m triangle-wave on a 10-22mm conformal offset) puts the wave valleys 12-24mm inside the body surface across y 0.98..1.51 (body f 0.55..0.86), fading at both band edges — which is where the shards are densest and where they fade. Degenerate triangles are negligible (542 below 1e-8 m^2, 81 below 1e-12) and sit near the collar, not the placket. Inward-facing normals (axis reference) are upper-heavy but dominated by correct inner-sleeve tube surfaces and accordion flank normals near dot~0; the nearest-surface reference is biased at free rims. Neither is the discriminator the interpenetration is.
